from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,base64,gzip,socket,subprocess,time
repo=Path('/home/jovyan/shares/SR003.nfs2/GENATATOR_PIPELINE/diploma_yandex_graphs');phase=repo/'experiments_iclr/postsubmission_20260930';assert Path.cwd()==repo and socket.gethostname()=='anogena-2-0'
assert subprocess.check_output(['nvidia-smi','--query-gpu=uuid','--format=csv,noheader'],text=True,timeout=10).splitlines()==['GPU-44039938-fd82-41d2-fefd-de71514e2fac']
for row in json.loads(gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(''))):
 rel=Path(row['path']);p=phase/rel;assert not rel.is_absolute() and '..' not in rel.parts and p.resolve().is_relative_to(phase.resolve()) and not p.exists()
 raw=base64.b64decode(row['b64']);assert len(raw)==row['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==row['sha256'];p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_bytes(raw);p.chmod(0o444)
root=phase/'citeseer_gnnm_initialization_pilot_execution_root_20261006_v2';owner=phase/'citeseer_gnnm_initialization_pilot_block_queue_preparation_20261006_v1/block_owner.py';cfg=root/'B0_BLOCK_OWNER_CONFIG.json';s=hashlib.sha256(cfg.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
argv=['/usr/bin/python3','-I','-S','-B',str(owner),'--config',str(cfg),'--config-sha256',s]
with (root/'block_owner.stdout.log').open('xb') as out,(root/'block_owner.stderr.log').open('xb') as err:child=subprocess.Popen(argv,cwd=repo,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=out,stderr=err,start_new_session=True)
time.sleep(.5);raw=(Path('/proc')/str(child.pid)/'stat').read_text();f=raw[raw.rfind(')')+2:].split();r={'owner_PID':child.pid,'start_ticks':int(f[19]),'sid':int(f[3]),'pgid':int(f[2]),'exit_code':child.poll(),'config_sha256':s,'stage':'detached_block_queue_waits_exact_warm_success'};(root/'BLOCK_QUEUE_LAUNCH.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(r));assert child.poll() is None and r['sid']==r['pgid']==child.pid
